changes: Implemented the LLM usage ledger WRITER FOUNDATION (Slice 1) in packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/: record.ts (types + strict validator — four cache-aware token fields, rejects stored totalTokens at any depth, usage.source enum, correlation/attribution/privacy/authority/integrity fields, per-dimension null!=0), ids.ts (mint ledgerCallId/attemptId/recordId + monotonic SequenceAllocator + supersedes; ids not derived from requestIdHash), writer.ts (single append-only choke-point with sha256 hash chain, genesis=null, caller integrity stripped, raw-content/secret deep-scan rejection, opt-in flag default OFF => strict no-op), summary.ts (informational reader; DerivedRecordTotal discriminated union so unknown is never coerced to 0; no gate consumption). Registered .lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl in runtime-artifact-registry.ts (materialHash=exclude, volatile, repairable, ignore .lattice/usage/). Added usage-ledger-smoke.ts (61 checks) wired as npm test:usage-ledger. No provider/estimate/budget/Authority wiring (deferred slices).
usage: Inert by default: set LATTICE_USAGE_LEDGER=1 to enable the append-only writer; otherwise appendUsageRecord is a strict no-op (no file, no dir). The module is the single foundation later slices wire through. Run npm --prefix packages/main run test:usage-ledger to see all 61 foundation checks pass.
expectedOutcome: npm run test:usage-ledger prints all-green (validator accepts valid + rejects stored-totalTokens/raw-content/malformed; writer hash-chains >=3 records + tamper detected; ids stable + supersedes; flag OFF => no file; registry classifies exclude/volatile/repairable; summary derived totals, no double-count, unknown!=0); build clean; only packages/main changed.
actualTranscript: verify-b-253e.mjs: TOTAL 75 | PASS 75 | FAIL 0 (buildOk smokePass singleAppender regOk optIn summaryNotGate scopeClean cjk=0). test:usage-ledger: 61/61. validate --story=B-253e: ALL PASS 75/75. 3 REVIEW reviewers (concept/quality/test-coverage) passed; round-1 quality findings F-001 (dead code) + F-002 (null-coercion footgun) fixed and resolved; escalation not required (1/2).
limitations: Foundation slice only — the ledger is opt-in and INERT by default; nothing writes real records until later slices wire providers/dispatch. No estimate path, no budget enforcement, no Authority receipt path.
pitfalls: Keep the single writer choke-point (only writer.ts does fs writes) when later slices wire providers — route through appendUsageRecord. Do not reintroduce a stored totalTokens or coerce unknown totals to 0 (DerivedRecordTotal is a discriminated union for that reason). The writer stays opt-in until a deliberate default-on rollout slice.
